Coram: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANIL KUMAR CHOUDHARY  For the Petitioner : Mr. K.S. Nanda , Adv.

For the State : Mr. Satish Prasad , Addl.PP.
02 / 09.05.2025 Heard the parties.

The petitioner has been made accused in connection with POCSO Case No.14 of 2024 arising out of Kersai P.S. Case No. 06 of 2024 instituted under Sections 376 DA, 506 of I.P.C. and under Section 6 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that the allegation against the petitioner is that the petitioner committed gang rape upon a woman under 16 years of age.
It is submitted that the allegation against the petitioner is false and so far, four witnesses including the victim have been examined in this case.
It is next submitted that the petitioner has been in jail custody since 09.03.2024, as mentioned in para 1 of this bail application.
It is next submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner is ready and willing to co-operate with the trial of the case hence, the petitioner may be admitted on regular bail.

Learned Addl. P.P. appearing for the State vehemently opposes the prayer for bail and submits that keeping in view the serious nature of allegation against the petitioner of committing gang rape upon the victim girl and the victim has supported the case of the prosecution and she has categorically Ravindar Baghwar Aged About 20 Years S/O ... vs The State Of Jharkhand ...

entities.text: Ravindar Baghwar Aged About 20 Years S/O ... vs The State Of Jharkhand
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is therefore submitted that the petitioner ought not be released on bail at this stage.

Considering the serious nature of allegation against the petitioner as well as the chance of his tampering with the evidence and absconding, if released on bail, this Court is of the considered view that this is not a fit case where the above-named petitioner be released on bail.
Accordingly, the prayer for bail of the above-named petitioner is rejected.

(ANIL KUMAR CHOUDHARY, J.) Smita/-
